execution.activation_requirement: A separate explicit implementation and pilot decision after the applicable gates pass; reading this file never enables work.

precedence.sampling_register: This register supersedes conflicting sample envelopes in earlier panel prose.
precedence.superseded_proposal: analysis-panel-round1.md E0 proposed up to 120 evaluation work families
precedence.replacement: 30 development work families proposed; extraction test target 80 work families with at most 8 sampled windows each; separate ASR calibration 6 development and 18 held-out excerpts

collection_scope.stage_completion: Verified audio plus metadata, or explicitly confirmed terminal source unavailability; quota, login, storage and generic errors are not success.

caption_policy.language_scope: English only: en and English regional variants

outside_project_bytes_must_include: project environments or caches outside the private root

shared_budget.current_limitation: Current ingestion Budget is process-local and assumes an exclusively owned ingestion run.
acceptable_designs: one coordinator owns every reservation/write/delete with worker IPC
transactional reservation store with an interprocess lock
shared_budget.fallback_until_implemented: Serialize collection and ASR under one ownership lock.
shared_budget.storage_pressure_behavior: Pause admissions and preserve pending work; do not report completion.

gpu.above_target_action: Increase idle time and pause new GPU admissions.
gpu.missing_telemetry_action: Pause GPU admissions; do not assume the device is idle.
gpu.oom_action: Bounded smaller-batch retries on CUDA, then defer.

candidate_transcription.compatibility_evidence: Tagged Windows build source and published package metadata; no local DLL or inference validation.
candidate_transcription.comparator_model: pinned CTranslate2 large-v3 in a separate run
candidate_transcription.standalone_cudnn_reason: The inspected CTranslate2 4.9.0 Windows build disables cuDNN convolution; actual wheel loading still requires a later smoke test.

artifact_contract.catalog_input: immutable catalog snapshot plus exact verified receipts

leases.alternative: An independently reserved ASR cache copy fetched from verified Drive storage.

reject: absolute or drive or UNC paths
zip_reader.raw_format_mapping: Versioned raw_format to legacy ext mapping; no guessing; compare catalog, raw member name and provenance.
zip_reader.missing_raw_identity_field: Use verified acquisition provenance for association; never claim the absent field was independently checked.

identifiers.leakage_group_id: split constraint joining confirmed copies and source/excerpt relationships without asserting full-content identity
identifiers.text_version_id: hash of canonical immutable derivation inputs
identifiers.span_id: immutable offsets within one text version

corpus_and_attribution.primary_view_policy: Freeze a coverage-aware qualifying full-recording version or interval composite before outcomes; retain source version/span mappings, uncovered intervals and all alternatives.

sampling_register.frame: dated frozen observed eligible English text view; not all channelers, all languages or missing speech

development.purpose: rubrics, lexicon, decoding, normalization and prompt development

extraction_test.claim_assignment: Window containing the first evidence token; adjacent context remains available.
extraction_test.first_stage: Stratified probability sample of eligible work families; freeze allocation after frame counts and collapse sparse strata by a documented rule.
extraction_test.second_stage_allocation_proposal: Start with min(2, stratum population) per nonempty stratum; redistribute remaining slots one at a time in the listed fixed stratum order among strata with remaining capacity, up to 8 total. Freeze before sampling; sample uniformly without replacement within each stratum.
extraction_test.uncertainty: Preserve two-stage design, work/leakage clustering and finite-population information; no ordinary binomial interval over enriched windows.

asr_calibration.development_pool: six eligible families within the proposed 30-work development frame
asr_calibration.held_out_pool: eligible untouched frame used by extraction evaluation; overlap with its sampled families is permitted only with separate purpose and selection records
asr_calibration.selection: Freeze offsets, hashes, coverage strata and actual inclusion mechanism before candidate outputs; purposive balancing is labeled purposive, not probability-representative.

contamination_rules: No leakage group crosses development/test boundaries.
Held-out guests cannot leak through host-channel development items.
Ambiguous dates spanning a cutoff are quarantined from the temporal test.
Later cross-split identity or duplicate merges invalidate affected metrics; do not silently resplit.
Held-out ASR mistakes cannot be used to tune downstream systems and then count as untouched downstream evaluation.

privacy.public_exports: allowlisted aggregates, reviewed public links and short reviewed excerpts that pass the existing quote/share guard

gates.acceptance: Imports/status/plan cause no model downloads, inference or job launches.
Concurrent reservation/write/crash fixtures preserve the shared byte ceiling and live-owner allocations.
Fresh whole-project inventory; all installer/model/temp paths and peak copies accounted; path escapes rejected.
Short/wrong-hash/changed-object/forged-receipt fixtures never promote text or delete source.
Bounded ZIP reader rejects corrupt/unsafe/empty/mismatched fixtures and preserves valid raw-span mappings.
Every deleter honors leases; PID reuse and upload/journal/delete crash fixtures recover without loss or overwrite.
Resolved hash lock, measured footprint, explicit CUDA smoke and one-owner rolling-load controller pass.
Long timeline and boundary fixtures retain offsets; identical derivations are idempotent; changed configurations append versions.
Frozen sample register, positive inclusion probabilities, leakage/person/date audit and coverage-aware selection pass.
Endpoint cooldown, disk pressure, GPU busy, STOP and termination fixtures remain bounded and resumable.
Authorized cold/warm/held-out pilot reports measured quality, timing, memory, disk, utilization and uncertainty.
Privacy export allowlist and untrusted-text fixtures prevent sensitive output or text-triggered tool actions.
